purpose: Shadow-only plumbing pilot: at the start of a kernel-lane round, would Eikos continue or stop? Recorded, never applied. See research/eikos_decision_audit_20261001.md sec 5.

next_step.instructions: This is the state of a GPU kernel-optimization run at the start of a new round. Should the run spend another optimization round, or stop now? tracked_incumbent_speedup is the run's tracked best (its commit is not independently confirmed); best_seen_speedup is the best verified candidate. Fields marked unknown were not measured; do not assume a value for them.

criteria.continue: Budget remains and another round has a realistic chance of a verified improvement over the committed best.
criteria.stop: Another round is unlikely to produce a verified improvement, or the remaining budget is too small to use.

criteria.true: Recent rounds added no verified improvement to the tracked best.
criteria.false: The most recent round improved the tracked best.

policy.note: would_be_action = the choice when its probability >= min_confidence, else abstain. Shadow pilot: recorded only, never applied. Threshold is a starting point, not calibrated.
